description: This file contains testing utilities for React components, including custom render functions with routing and context providers, as well as mock fetch functions for testing network requests.

methods.name: renderWithRouter
methods.description: Renders a React component wrapped in router context, either using BrowserRouter or MemoryRouter based on the router type specified.

methods.name: renderWithAppProvider
methods.description: Wraps a React component with AppProvider context and routing for testing purposes.

methods.name: mockFetchOnce
methods.description: Mocks a fetch call to resolve with specified data and response parameters for one call, simulating a successful network request.

methods.name: mockFetchOnceError
methods.description: Mocks a fetch call to resolve with an error response for one call, simulating a failed network request.
